preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The length of string T is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The total cost of transformations is between 0 and 500 inclusive.
Strings S and T contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximal number of occurrences of string S in the transformed string T' with a total transformation cost not exceeding K.
